name: 우츠로
quote: 비어버린 껍데기에 남은 것은 오직 굶주림뿐이다.
silhouette: 거대한 입의 실루엣, 몽둥이를 든 비대칭 체형, 흩날리는 머리카락
signature_motion: 체력이 낮아지면 몸을 떨며 더 빠르게 돌진함
signature_vfx: 입 주변에서 뿜어져 나오는 형광 연두색 안개
visual_en: A small 2-unit scale creature facing right, featuring an unnaturally large gaping mouth with glowing neon lime eyes. The head is covered in messy ash-grey hair, with a pale purple skin tone. It wears a tattered, deep crimson monk robe decorated with ornate gold trims. Around its neck, a broken Buddhist prayer bead string hangs loosely. It holds a massive, thick white bone club. As its health decreases, the skin turns a bright, angry red, and the neon lime eyes glow much more intensely.
pose_en: Lurching forward with a hungry, manic expression.
vfx_en: Swirling neon lime mist emanating from the mouth.
stages: 체력이 깎여 분노한 모습 — 몸이 붉게 달아오르고 더 거칠어 보인다
